notes.title: ✨Quality of Life Demo Update!✨
notes.notes: [p]The [b]Quality of Life[/b] Update for the Jurassic Gym Demo is out right now![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3782040/Jurassic_Gym_Demo"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]QoL Update Changelog:[/p][list][*][p]A new Jurassic Era invention... the Clipboard! A new Overview screen so you can quickly access a list of ALL dinosaurs and ALL equipment in one place! No more clicking on each individual item to find what you need. You can access the Overview in the popout menu in the bottom left of the screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611124/8b5bb2bcb34d4a4a3ad473c4ad46265c20fb5410.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Support for Ultra-Wide Displays added.[/p][/*][*][p]An assortment of UI bug fixes and adjustments (and performance improvements, wow!).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Download the update now and manage your gym with superior efficiency![/p][p]And as always, if you have any feedback or bug reports, you can always reach out on our [url="https://discord.gg/HhAvHaCqsM"]Discord [/url]or [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3695640/discussions/"]Steam Discussion Board[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Have Fun![/p]

notes.title: 🦕 Jurassic Gym Demo is live for Next Fest! 🦕
notes.notes: [p]The Jurassic Gym Demo is available to play RIGHT NOW, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3782040/Jurassic_Gym_Demo"]right here on Steam[/url]! You can have your own dinosaur gym on the bottom of your screen as you go on with your day! [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3782040/Jurassic_Gym_Demo"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]🖊️ Give Your Feedback! 🖊️[/h2][p]Features are still being added and tweaks are always being made as the game gets developed, so be sure to either leave a review of the demo, head over to our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3695640/discussions"]Steam Discussion Board[/url], or join our teeny [url="https://discord.gg/3sbvtKVM"]Discord Server[/url] and leave your feedback (no matter how small, it all matters!).[/p][p][/p][h2]✨ Wishlist the Game! ✨[/h2][p]If you enjoyed the demo, or just like what you see and want to save it all up for the full release, be sure to add Jurassic Gym to your wishlist so you can be notified when it's out![/p][p][/p][p]                                        [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611124/15b4d8694e4b7d3add938e28118db6d5123046db.gif"][/img][/p][p]                                                                                   [i]Wee![/i][/p]
